Read the results object of a project version

Source: R/read_results.R
read_results.Rd

read_results() reads the results.qs2 of one scenario, and the results_gitexclude.qs2 beside it, the files that save_results() writes. The default reads the real results.

Usage

read_results(version, scenario = "real", sim = NULL, home = ".")

Arguments

version

The version, for example "v01".

scenario

The scenario. The default is "real".

sim

NULL, or the number of one simulation.

home

The project folder.

Value

The results object, a named list. See save_results().

Details

With sim = NULL, read_results() reads <home>/<version>_results/<scenario>/results.qs2. That is the results of a scenario with 1 simulation, or the simulations that save_results() stacked. With a number k, it reads <home>/<version>_results/<scenario>/sims_gitexclude/sim_<kkkk>.qs2, where <kkkk> is k with four digits. git ignores that folder, so a clone of the repository has no such file. Then read_results() stops, and the error says to run the scenario with run_plan() and save_results(). For a scenario with 1 simulation, sim = 1 reads its results.qs2, the results of that simulation. The section The files of save_results() shows each file.

read_results() stops when <home>/<version>_results/<scenario>/check.csv exists and holds a value of pass that is not TRUE, also when it reads one simulation. It also stops when that file holds no assertion, or has no column pass that R can read. save_results() still writes such results, so that you can find the fault. The error names the file and how to read it with qs2::qs_read().

For "real", read_results() also stops when manifest$failed_fake_checks names a fake scenario. save_results() writes into it each fake scenario of the same run with a failed assertion. The real data and the fake scenarios run through the same code. So a fake scenario with a failed assertion can show a fault in the code of the real results. The error names each such scenario, the path of its check.csv and the fix.

The run that writes the real results writes this record. A run of "real" alone records no fake scenario with a failed assertion. A later run of a fake scenario alone does not change the record of the real results. Real results of pbn 2026.11.24 or older have no failed_fake_checks, and read_results() reads them as before.

read_results() returns one list with the elements of both files. The order is that of a results object: manifest, exclusions, and the analysis kinds in the order of manifest$analyses. These rules apply to results_gitexclude.qs2, and to sim_<kkkk>_gitexclude.qs2 for one simulation:

  • When the manifest names kinds in it and the file is missing, it returns the elements of the results file. A clone of the repository has no such file. It gives one warning that names the missing kinds and the file.

  • It stops when the file holds other kinds than the manifest names, also when the manifest names none.

A manuscript MUST read the real results only. check_project() fails a call in manuscript/built/ that gives a scenario other than "real".

See also

Other results: check_results(), render_run(), save_results()
